source='''def transform(grid):
    """Copy the rare-color polyomino into every all-zero translated location."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value != 0:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points}
    shape_h = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    shape_w = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - shape_h + 1):
        for c in range(w - shape_w + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = color
    return out
'''
